questions.question: How does David describe the LORD at the start of Psalm 144?
options: My rock, who trains my hands for war
My light, who scatters the darkness of night
My portion, who fills my cup with joy
My shepherd, who leads me beside still waters
questions.answer: My rock, who trains my hands for war

questions.question: What does David ask about man, marveling at God's care?
options: Who is able to number all the many days of a single man?
What is man that you regard him, since he is like a breath?
Why is man made to be so strong and mighty above the beasts?
Where does the spirit of a man go away to when at last he dies?
questions.answer: What is man that you regard him, since he is like a breath?

questions.question: David says blessed is the people whose God is the LORD.
Blessed be the LORD, my _____, who trains my hands for war.
I will sing a new _____ to you, O God; upon a ten-stringed harp I will play to you.
